did: Studio on the phone gained Spoken: you paste a spoken card, read each part on the teleprompter Studio already had, with Kokoro's question above it, or say it in your own words, and every take is kept on home with its card and part. Copy for the essay hands a session each question with the take that answers it, so the essay plays your takes as you said them; nothing is shared out or cut by hand. The reach came first and you approved the screens before any code; the card's categories now live once in video-render for the essay's render to read too.
left: The branch claude/studio-scripts-w5 from the first name is still on GitHub: neither this session nor the coordinator could delete it.
A code comment in Spoken's runtime cites HEARD, which names no declared ID; it should point at WALK7's own refusal of an unheard take, on the next push there.
